-- An actual native refutation forces halting even when no formula invariant is supplied.
example (st : L2.AS) (h : BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot) :
    RMDag.IterHalts Dag254.dag254 (L2.enc st) :=
  DirtyProgram254.complete_from st (NativeTheory254.c254_refutation_iff.mpr h)

-- The six arbitrary fields remain explicit all the way to the actual native theory.
example (N A D X Y L : Nat) :
    (¬ BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot) ↔
      ¬ RMDag.IterHalts Dag254.dag254 (L2.enc ⟨N,0,0,A,D,0,X,Y,L⟩) :=
  not_congr (DirtyProgram254.six_nonformula_iff N A D X Y L).symm

-- A supplied nonempty native model excludes every safe dirty path start.
example (D : Type) (mem : D → D → Prop) (v : Nat → D)
    (h : ∀ f, NativeTheory254.NativeAx f → Sat mem v f)
    (st : L2.AS) (hs : DirtyProgram254.Safe st) :
    ¬ RegisterPath.Halts RMEquiv254.pathDag254 ⟨[], L2.enc st⟩ := by
  intro hh
  exact soundness_BProv ((DirtyProgram254.path_halts_iff_native_refutation st hs).mp hh)
    v h (fun _ hNil => by cases hNil)

-- The absorption preserves the final full register file for every structured exit.
example (st : L2.AS) (e : RMDag.Exit) (Q : RMDag.Regs) :
    RMDag.Run Dag254.dag254 (.node 0) (L2.enc st) e Q ↔
      RMDag.Run Dag254.dag254 (.node 0) (L2.enc (DirtyRoot254.virtual st)) e Q :=
  DirtyRoot254.root_equiv st e Q
